name: WINNIE LEDGER
note: WINNIE AT THE END OF THE COUNTER (doc 57 F5: 'Winnie is at the end of the counter'; doc 04 WIN_C... 'I'll be at the Registrar's when you do'). Her accepted Room 5 counter sheet, behind Room 7's counter beside the right-hand lamp. She signs beside the sample and certifies the filing; the room hands on to the dawn when it is filed, so she is never seen to go.
barksNote: Her lines at the filing are the counter's and SUM_F1's (doc 57 F5).
